title: Skeleton Durable State Backup and Retention Policy
objective: Create verifiable, retention-governed backups of authoritative SQLite state before destructive change and on the operator backup cadence, without treating derived projections as canonical authority.
invariants: authoritative SQLite files are backed up with SQLite online backup semantics rather than filesystem copy while live
a backup is not valid until every required store passes SQLite integrity_check and its manifest digest is recorded
restore verification precedes operation outbox reconciliation, engine execution recovery, governance actions and derived projection rebuild
a newer verified backup must exist before retention pruning can remove an older verified backup
backup manifests contain no provider credentials or application secrets

stores.post_restore: verify operation identity/state/version and pending outbox identity, then reconcile outbox
verify execution/turn/checkpoint/result identity and recover resumable executions
verify idempotent submission acknowledgements and approval bindings
preserve committed and in-doubt tool idempotency fences before replay
verify reservations/completions/usage before admitting new engine work
reconfigure policy and reap expired leases before admission
validate lifecycle schema and outstanding deletion/export state before governance actions
reopen replay state and reconcile unpublished authoritative operation outbox rows

backup_triggers: before state-store replacement or volume migration

required_sequence: verify SQLite integrity and manifest digests
reconcile authoritative outboxes and recover resumable executions
